hboat.source: Slice wave method, model A (experiments/unified-physics/w2-slicewaves, run_boats.py): H-boat class table of offsets, 83 sections every 0.1 m (reference model class_hboat.mjs, hboat_sea.json); canoe body below the static sailing waterline. Upright, static attitude, no sinkage or trim, appendages left out. Fraction of canoe-body weight (rho g x 1.595 m3) against Froude number on a waterline of 6.386 m. Raw model output, no smoothing.

ifboat.source: Slice wave method, model A (experiments/unified-physics/w2-slicewaves, run_boats.py): International Folkboat demo data: half-ellipse sections from published main dimensions and estimates (reference model boats_def.mjs, hulls.json). Upright, static attitude, no sinkage or trim, appendages left out. Fraction of canoe-body weight (rho g x 1.950 m3) against Froude number on a waterline of 6.030 m. Raw model output, no smoothing.
